files.title: File:Union Block, Herrick Avenue, Wellington, OH - 54431358517.jpg
files.author: w_lemay
files.caption: Built in 1872, this Italianate-style building is known as the Union Block.  The building is clad in red brick with exterior brick piers, arched window bays with decorative hoods, and a first floor facade with multiple large bays flanked by cast iron piers.  The building is a contributing structure in the Wellington Center Historic District, listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1974, and the Wellington Historic District, listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1979.
